entries.zh: 关门、闩门（用门闩把门关上）
entries.en: to close the door with a latch or bolt
to shut the mouth; the mouth

entries.zh: 把东西放入口中含住（落含）
entries.en: to hold something in the mouth, lips closed
to close the mouth (bring the lips together)
to close the mouth tightly

entries.zh: 禁口禁嘴：闭嘴不食不言
entries.en: to shut the mouth, forbidding both eating and speaking
to clench the fist
to close the eyes (shut them, as in sleep)

entries.zh: 放下盖子扣合、钳落盖上
entries.en: to close by letting the lid drop onto it
to wrap up and seal a letter (with enclosing sheets)
to tie the purse shut (knot it closed)
to shut close (put the cover on top)
to close and seal a city gate; to lock it down

entries.zh: 掩门、把门掩上（自内关门）
entries.en: to shut the door (push it closed from within)
to bolt or shut the door

entries.zh: 疮口收合（疮口自行收口愈合）
entries.en: for the sore or wound to close up (heal shut)
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头栏为空，汉字栏疑为“縫口”且本身标注存疑，四栏材料不足以定释义。

entries.en: ridge, hill (uncertain; Spanish reads 'the mouth opens, unbarred')
entries.notes: 西语释义与汉字单字“陵”难以对应，疑词条错位或为“嶺”之误写，姑依陵/嶺山岭义姑拟。

entries.en: low hills, small ridges
a low hill or knoll; small ridge of the mountain
hills of the mountain; knolls on high ground
